Expected packets worked out from OpenRGB's C++ (commit d4798c120659ec5ba2e664a9e87bedff8d36f880, Controllers/AsusAuraUSBController: AsusAuraUSBController.cpp SendDirect / GetFirmwareVersion / GetConfigTable, AsusAuraMainboardController.cpp constructor / SetGen1 / SendEffect, AsusAuraAddressableController.cpp constructor / SendEffect, RGBController_AsusAuraUSB.cpp SetupZones / DeviceUpdateLEDs / DeviceUpdateMode) by a separate Python reference model that mirrors those functions buffer by buffer, unsigned char arithmetic included (openrgb-work/batch2/asus/gen_aura_usb.py in the porting session's scratch space, not part of the repository); plugin.js was never run to make them. Every report is a 65-byte output report (hid_write), report id 0xEC first, as hex. 'initialize': the writes of the constructor (firmware request, config table request, mainboards: SetGen1); the device answers with firmware_reply and config_reply. 'frame_a': the first update (DeviceUpdateMode's Direct effect for zones with LEDs, then SetChannelLEDs per zone). 'frame_b': a later update. 'shutdown': Lightloom's exit (OpenRGB has none): the same direct reports with black. Colours are per zone in LED order; channel_counts are the LED counts the test gives each addressable header (OpenRGB: the user-set zone size).
